lessons.title: Ask a useful question
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Start with a clear question and choose a few specific search words. Narrow the question if the results are too broad. A useful search goal helps you decide which results are relevant.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Check the source
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Look for who created the material and why. An official source may explain its methods or link to evidence, but you should still check whether it addresses your question. Popularity alone does not establish accuracy.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Read beyond headlines
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
A headline may omit context. Read the full claim, check its date and distinguish evidence from opinion. Note what the resource does not explain before making a decision.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Compare independent evidence
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Compare a claim with another reliable source. Several websites copying the same statement are not independent confirmation. If reliable sources disagree, describe the uncertainty and keep investigating.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Share responsibly
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Before sharing, check whether the resource is relevant, credible and current. Include the original source when possible and avoid presenting an uncertain claim as established fact. Correct a mistake when you discover one.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.
